title: Sizeable Foliage
description: Adding more sizes to existing foliage!
body: # Sizeable Foliage **Are you tired of the same bush and grass foliage? Well then this is the mod for you!**  **\*Recommended to be paired with Swing Through Grass\*** ## **Introducing the new flora (Lance for scale):** *** ### **Big Bush!** **The big brother of the vanilla bush. This beast of a plant can be bonemealed up to 2 times to increase its size!** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1781/640/2026-07-08_22-31-04-png.png)** *** ### **Very Tall Grass!** **Its been awhile since you mowed hasn't it...** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1781/649/2026-07-08_22-50-32-png.png)** *** ### **Very Short Grass!** **Your lawn has never felt more fluffy!** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1781/653/2026-07-08_23-00-48-png.png)** *** ### **Torchflower Bush!** **The torchflower got a growth spurt! And now it glows!** **![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1781/686/2026-07-08_23-13-40-png.png)** *** ## **Planned Potential Features** - Big Crimson Bush - Big Warped Bush - Fern Wall - Big Lilypad - Sweet Berry Bush *** [![](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/055924f3-97f3-4858-8c05-bf30a1aa9906.png)](https://www.bisecthosting.com/laynce)    We've spent thousands of hours on our mods. We learned Java specifically for this. If you've enjoyed our projects, a great way to support us is through Patreon! Click on the above picture to get a server, use code laynce to get 25% off your first month and enjoy playing with your friends! Set up is so easy, it's basically one click. Click on the picture bellow for Craisin's patreon to directly support him. You'll get exclusive discord roles, chats, and get to directly influence the development of mods! Join the Discord by clicking on the image or link below if you run into an issue of any kind or have a suggestion, I'll try my best to respond to everyone and would absolutely love suggestions! Thanks for playing and supporting my mod!                                https://discord.com/invite/72a7jmc5mb
